examples.name: Basic table (columns + data)
examples.jsx:
<Table
  caption="Team members"
  getRowId={(m) => m.id}
  columns={[
    { key: 'name', header: 'Name', sortable: true },
    { key: 'role', header: 'Role' },
    { key: 'joined', header: 'Joined', align: 'end' },
  ]}
  data={members}
/>

examples.name: Identifier as a strong Link; other columns at body weight
examples.jsx:
<Table
  caption="Team members"
  getRowId={(m) => m.id}
  columns={[
    { key: 'name', header: 'Name', sortable: true, emphasis: 'strong', render: (m) => (
      <Link href={`/members/${m.id}`} emphasis="strong">{m.name}</Link>
    ) },
    { key: 'status', header: 'Status', render: (m) => <Tag tone={m.status === 'Active' ? 'success' : 'neutral'}>{m.status}</Tag> },
  ]}
  data={members}
/>

examples.name: Selectable with a bulk-actions bar
Client-side pagination + sort
examples.jsx:
<Table
  caption="Team members"
  getRowId={(m) => m.id}
  columns={columns}
  data={members}
  defaultSort={{ columnKey: 'name', direction: 'asc' }}
  pageSize={10}
/>

examples.name: Server-driven (manual sort + pagination)
examples.jsx:
<Table
  caption="Orders"
  getRowId={(o) => o.id}
  columns={columns}
  data={pageRows}
  manualSort
  sort={sort}
  onSortChange={(next) => { setSort(next); refetch({ sort: next, page }); }}
  manualPagination
  page={page}
  pageCount={totalPages}
  onPageChange={(next) => { setPage(next); refetch({ sort, page: next }); }}
  loading={isFetching}
/>

examples.name: Full list page (header + toolbar + grid + pagination)
examples.jsx:
<Table
  title="All members"
  description="Everyone with access to this workspace."
  actions={<><Button appearance="subtle">Export</Button><Button appearance="primary">Invite member</Button></>}
  getRowId={(m) => m.id}
  columns={columns}
  data={filtered}
  searchable
  searchValue={search}
  onSearchChange={setSearch}
  filters={<Select aria-label="Role" placeholder="Role" inputType="multi" options={roleOptions} value={role} onChange={setRole} />}
  onClearFilters={() => { setSearch(''); setRole([]); }}
  activeFilters={role.map((r) => ({ id: r, label: r, onRemove: () => setRole((p) => p.filter((x) => x !== r)) }))}
  selectable
  pageSize={10}
/>

antiExamples.name: No accessible name
antiExamples.reason: A table needs an accessible name - pass `caption` (or a `title`), rendered as a visually-hidden <caption>.

antiExamples.name: Index row ids with selection
antiExamples.reason: The default row id is the index, which is unstable once rows sort or paginate - selection would attach to the wrong rows. Pass a real `getRowId`.

antiExamples.name: Baking domain filters into the table
antiExamples.jsx: <Table columns={columns} data={rows} statusFilter typeFilter /* invented props */ />
antiExamples.reason: Table does not know your filter domain. Render your Selects in the `filters` slot and drive `data` + `activeFilters` from your own state.

antiExamples.name: A data table for a card grid
antiExamples.reason: A dashboard of cards is a layout grid, not tabular data - use layout primitives, not <table> semantics.
